response.query: Which local empirical datasets (carbon pools, streamflow gauges, soil-loss plots, evapotranspiration observations) and protocols will we use to calibrate and independently validate InVEST modules?
response.answer: We will use local datasets from carbon pools, streamflow gauges, soil-loss plots, and evapotranspiration observations to calibrate and validate InVEST modules. Protocols include standard empirical methods for each dataset type.
